name: bottom-navigation

frames.best_why: Shows the full labelled tab bar with Home active over the payment list, with no cursor covering it.

tagline: Floating tab bar that shrinks to icons while its content scrolls.
summary: A mobile bottom tab bar floating over a payment list. It highlights the active tab, shows labels under each icon, and collapses to bare icons as the list scrolls.
appearance: A dark rounded phone card holds a scrollable payment list above a floating pill-shaped bar of four tabs with labels, plus a round plus button beside it. The active tab sits in a lighter capsule.
behaviour: Scrolling the list up minimises the bar to icon-sized circles and folds the labels away; scrolling back or tapping restores it. Choosing a tab slides the light capsule under it, and icons dip slightly when pressed.
demo_content: Payment rows like Corner Bakery €4.60 and Hotel Lumen €256.73 with times.
search_phrases: floating app navigation at the bottom
tab bar that shrinks when scrolling
app menu pinned to the screen bottom
use_when: A mobile app screen needs primary destinations always within thumb reach while content scrolls.
avoid_when: Scrolling changes the bar's size, so the tabs move while you scroll; it targets touch, not desktop pointers.
customise: Tabs, labels and icons are composed as children; value, scroll behaviour, label layout and the accessory are props, while springs live in a shared motion-token file.
weight_why: A few motion values and one scroll listener; no animation loop and no heavy rendering.

a11y.note: Buttons carry aria-labels, aria-current marks the active tab, and motion honours prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Polished floating bar with smooth label folding and a clear active capsule.
